name: kb_matvec
description: Matrix-vector multiplication: y = A @ x. Unlike full matrix multiplication, this is bandwidth-bound rather than compute-bound because one dimension has no tiling opportunities. Critical for efficient linear layer inference with batch_size=1.

m.description: Number of rows in A (output vector length)

k.description: Number of columns in A (input vector length)

name: kb_matvec_tall_skinny
description: Matrix-vector multiplication optimized for tall-skinny matrices (m >> k). Common in linear projections from small hidden states to large vocabularies.

m.description: Number of rows in A (output vector length, typically large vocabulary size)

k.description: Number of columns in A (input vector length, typically hidden dimension)

name: kb_matvec_short_wide
description: Matrix-vector multiplication optimized for short-wide matrices (k >> m). Common in down-projections or feature extraction layers.

m.description: Number of rows in A (output vector length, typically smaller dimension)

k.description: Number of columns in A (input vector length, typically larger dimension)

name: kb_matvec_transposed
description: Matrix-vector multiplication with transposed matrix: y = A^T @ x. Memory access pattern differs from standard matvec, requiring different optimization strategies.

m.description: Number of columns in A (output vector length)

k.description: Number of rows in A (input vector length)
